value.answer: I'm sorry things feel heavy enough that you're looking for a therapist. If it gets urgent at any point, go to the nearest emergency room or call local emergency services right away. The cheapest route I found in Toronto is the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy Program: it's free, you don't need a health card or a family doctor, and you can self-refer at ontariohealth.ca/osp by filling out the referral form. It's mainly for depression and anxiety, and an intake clinician decides if it's a fit. Toronto Community Psychotherapy & Counselling Centre offers free counselling through an application, often based on income. Supervised training clinics run about $45 to $50 a session, though those prices come from older listings and may have changed.
